# Aura Arcana

> Aura Arcana (auralarcana.com) is a free supernatural tarot website paired with the
> YouTube music channel "Aural Arcana: Sonic Mysteries". It offers interactive tarot
> readings in the browser, interpretations of all 78 tarot cards, a tarot practice
> guide, and a library of original atmospheric music for tarot readings, divination,
> meditation, ritual and focus.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

## What the site offers

- Free interactive tarot reading at /tarot/ : four spreads (one card daily, Past
  Present Future, Situation Challenge Direction, and a five card Compass), drawn
  from the full 78 card deck with optional reversed cards. No account, no payment,
  readings are not stored.
- Meanings of all 78 tarot cards at /cards/ : every Major and Minor Arcana card has
  its own page with symbolism, upright and reversed meanings, keywords and
  reflective questions.
- Music library at /music/ : original compositions from the YouTube channel
  (youtube.com/@aural_arcana), organized by purpose: music for tarot readings,
  mystical and supernatural atmospheres, otherworldly dark ambient, focus and
  study, epic cinematic, and short "sonic mysteries" video essays.
- Tarot guide at /guide/ : articles on how to approach a reading, Major vs Minor
  Arcana, choosing a spread, and how music and atmosphere deepen divination.

## Positioning and tone

Tarot on Aura Arcana is framed as symbolic reflection, insight and entertainment,
never as verified prediction, medical, legal or financial advice. All card
interpretations and all music are original work.
